output=[]
for file,snapshot in pairs:
    old=(root/snapshot).read_bytes(); new=(root/file).read_bytes()
    assert old==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+file])
    def facts(raw):
        tree=ast.parse(raw)
        groups={'asserts':[], 'mock_checks':[], 'raises':[]}
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node,ast.Assert): groups['asserts'].append(ast.dump(node,include_attributes=False))
            if isinstance(node,ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func,ast.Attribute):
                if node.func.attr.startswith('assert_'): groups['mock_checks'].append(ast.dump(node,include_attributes=False))

    # Exactly the fixture lambdas' accepted keywords changed; full module

    old_tree,new_tree=ast.parse(old),ast.parse(new)

    new_lambdas=[n for n in ast.walk(new_tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Lambda)]
    assert len(old_lambdas)==len(new_lambdas)

            left.args.kwarg=right.args.kwarg

    output.append({'path':file,'snapshot':snapshot,'snapshot_sha256':sha(old),'sha256':sha(new),'accepted_keyword_lambdas_changed':changed,'preserved':{key:len(value) for key,value in before.items()},'assert_ast_sha256':sha(json.dumps(before['asserts'],ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode())})
